title: Lindbergh flew across the Atlantic with no window to look ahead

cover.alt: Grainy black-and-white film still: the Spirit of St. Louis, a silver high-winged monoplane, races across a misty airfield on its takeoff run.

body: Lindbergh asked Ryan Airlines to put the *Spirit of St. Louis*’s main fuel tank in front of the cockpit. That improved the plane’s balance and made it less likely he would be crushed in a crash, but it left no room for a windscreen. To see ahead he looked out of the side windows, swinging the nose slightly, and a periscope was fitted for flying low. On 20 May 1927, carrying 450 US gallons (1,700 litres) of fuel, he took off from Roosevelt Field on Long Island, and he landed at Le Bourget near Paris the next day.

slides.alt: Black-and-white newsreel: Lindbergh leans out of the plane’s side window; then the monoplane rolls slowly across a misty field, passes close to the camera and lifts into the air.
slides.caption: May 1927: Lindbergh at the cockpit’s side window, then the fuel-laden plane’s long, slow run across Roosevelt Field before it lifts off.
slides.music: “Our Story Begins” Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) · CC BY 4.0

slides.prompt: With a fuel tank where the windscreen would be, how did Lindbergh see where he was going?
slides.answer: Through the side windows, and a periscope
slides.detail: He turned the plane slightly to look past the nose. A Ryan employee fitted a periscope he helped design, though it is unclear whether he used it on the flight.

slides.label: alone in the air between New York and Paris, about 5,800 km
slides.text: It was the first solo nonstop flight across the Atlantic, and it won Lindbergh the Orteig Prize.

slides.heading: The prize was worth more than twice the plane
slides.note: 1927 dollars. The Spirit of St. Louis Organization paid the rest of the plane’s cost.

slides.heading: Which one did the plane carry?
slides.explanation: To save weight Lindbergh left out a radio, refused to carry souvenir letters and cut the top and bottom off his map. The periscope was fitted.
